methodology.finishRank: Players are ranked within position and season by total fantasy points for the selected scoring format.
methodology.ppg: A finisher's total fantasy points divided by nflverse games.
methodology.average: The PPG values at each positional finish are averaged across 5 completed seasons.
methodology.ties: Ties in total points are resolved by PPG, then nflverse player ID.
methodology.rankCapping: Ranks beyond the generated positional depth use the last available rank.
methodology.sleeperPlayerFilter: Players must appear on the nflverse 2026 NFL roster, be active in Sleeper, and have Sleeper search rank 1-500 or depth-chart order 1-3. Teamless stale and retired Sleeper records are excluded.

nflverse.name: nflverse player summary statistics
nflverse.attribution: Data provided by nflverse. Underlying NFL data may be governed by its respective owners' terms.

nflverseRoster.name: nflverse current-season roster
nflverseRoster.usage: Current roster eligibility, team, and roster status; used to exclude retired and stale Sleeper records.

sleeper.name: Sleeper NFL player directory
sleeper.usage: Position-filtered player metadata; collected by this script and never requested by the browser.
